info.title: CPRS API
info.description:
Client PO Requirements System — resolve what a garment PO requires (labels, hangtags, packing, carton marking, compliance) for G-III brands, plus reference data, search, images, and export.

Auth: send `x-api-key: <CPRS_API_KEY>` (service) or `Authorization: Bearer <token>` (user). Public routes: /api/v1/health, /api/v1/login, /api/v1/chat. All paths include the /api/v1 prefix.

servers.description: Local CPRS server (all paths include the /api/v1 prefix)

domain.description: Requirement domain (e.g. label, hangtag, packaging, carton).

subtype.description: Subtype within the domain (e.g. main_label, main_hangtag).

conditionGroup.description: Conditions in the same group are ANDed.

approvedValue.description: Required when decision = 'corrected': the corrected structured_output.

warehouseCode.description: Destination DC code — drives RFID / MSRP / label language (e.g. DKNY UC/DN, KL NJ/CN/DS/CX). Not on the PO.

destinationWarehouseId.description: Warehouse id (use instead of warehouseCode if known).

accountCode.description: Retailer/account code (e.g. MACYS, AMRG, ROSS, TR098).

accountId.description: Account id (use instead of accountCode if known).

styleId.description: Style id — resolves garment attributes when provided.

garmentCategory.description: Garment category, used when styleId is not given.

coo.description: Country of origin — drives FTA / ISPM-15 screens.

contextFields.description: Runtime gates & feature flags. Gate keys are is_* / has_*; answering false makes a gated requirement resolve not_applicable. e.g. { "has_belt": false, "has_buttons": false, "is_cotton_shirt": false }.

title.description: Winning requirement's title (null for not_applicable/conflict rows).

scope.description: 'corporate' = G-III Global company-wide rule auto-joined at tier 7; 'brand' = client rule.

images.description: Pictures for the winning requirement (max 6): {id, caption, sheet, sourceFile, url}. CPRS-generated artwork (rendered, not a manual scan) carries "generated": true — both ingested renders and on-demand fallbacks. Fetch url with the same auth.

clientId.description: Brand/client id (see GET /clients). Provide this OR `brand`.

brand.description: Brand name, matched to a client (e.g. "DKNY Sportswear", "Karl Lagerfeld", "Calvin Klein").

poNumber.description: PO number — its 2-char suffix is tried as the warehouse code (e.g. …UC, …DN); its prefix can also nominate the brand when `brand`/`clientId` are omitted (e.g. CSKHHN→CK, DUKHHA→DKNY, LKHHN→KL).

style.description: Style number — its prefix can nominate the brand when `brand`/`clientId` are omitted (e.g. S5DT/X5DT→CK, UJ6T→DKNY, G5DT/GP6D→KL). Only narrows candidates; evidence still picks the division.

shipTo.description: Raw ship-to address — resolved to a warehouse code when warehouseCode/PO-suffix do not.
shipTo.example: G-III / DKNY, 8 SANTE FE WAY, CRANBURY, NJ 08512

warehouseCode.description: Explicit destination warehouse code (overrides PO-suffix / ship-to).

account.description: Account / customer text from the "(FOR …)" line — matched to an account.

channel.description: Sales channel; inferred from the account type when omitted.

coo.description: Country of origin — drives FTA / ISPM-15 screens.

contextFields.description: Runtime gates & flags (is_*/has_*). e.g. { "has_belt": false, "has_buttons": false }.

ship_to.description: Raw ship-to address string from the PO.
ship_to.example: G-III / DKNY, 8 SANTE FE WAY, CRANBURY, NJ 08512

addresses.description: All ship-to strings from one PO (1–500).

match_keywords.description: Keywords used to match a ship-to string.

question.example: What hangtag does TJX Australia (TR098) need for KL?

clientId.description: Scope the answer to one brand.

fileContextId.description: Id of a previously uploaded file to use as context.

clientId.description: Client whose active fiber-terminology requirement to check against. Optional — the rule text is global, so any active rule (or the built-in default) is used when omitted.
